g.text: One MoE layer of one decode step, on one GPU
DeepEP dispatch send each token to the GPUs that own its experts
recv_x [E_local, T, H] fp8 masked_m [E_local] int32
GEMM 1 (gate-up) expert e: rows [0, masked_m[e]) only
gateup [E_local, T, 2D] bf16 (each row = gate | up)
SiLU x mul + FP8 quant (this kernel)
q [E_local, T, D] fp8 scales [E_local, D/512, T] int32 (Blackwell)
GEMM 2 (down) expert e: rows [0, masked_m[e]) only
DeepEP combine send rows back, add the topk outputs x topk_weights
masked_m is written on the GPU by dispatch. The host cannot read it without a sync,
and a sync breaks the CUDA graph, so every launch is sized for T rows per expert.
rows per expert = max b x GPUs
